_comment: What the repo has loaded from each external data source. scripts/data-watch/check.mjs compares these with what each publisher has released and opens a GitHub issue when there is something newer. Update the entry in the same PR that loads the new data. DEFRA is read from RELEASES in scripts/build-defra-factors.mjs and CPI from lib/calculation/price-index.ts, so they are not listed here.

iso-editions._comment: Latest edition year the management systems catalogue holds for each standard, and the ISO page read to spot a newer one.

national-libraries._comment: Editions loaded for AU, CA, DE, IE (lib/factors/national-libraries.ts). Not yet watched automatically; recheck each year.
